title: Boolean junta from relevant coordinates
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ and let $r$ be a nonnegative integer. If at most $r$ coordinates have positive influence on the real-valued function obtained by viewing the signs of $f$ as real numbers, then $f$ depends on at most $r$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
The number of coordinates with positive influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ is at most $r$
